source_shapes: Two upper dimples and central star-like folds, following the first native pattern. These are pillow tufts, not a face.
Four source dimple positions at top, left, right and lower center; retain the diamond arrangement.
Plain upper pad with deeper lower-front edge folds; no new visible top buttons are added where the source has none.
A diagonal sequence of pinched folds/dimples follows the original stepped diagonal marks; no readable slash symbol or embroidery.

palette.rule: Upper stuffed fabric receives w; pale lower/front binding receives y. Crease/button marks are shaded primary fabric, not transparent holes. Cyan binding in authoring is an extraction aid; final layers are neutral.

default_reference.binding: Same alpha coverage and same shader-relevant R wherever covered as RandomTile variant1. Raw RGBA differs only in invisible RGB; no extra visible fifth model is required.

render_reference.drawSize: No explicit value in inspected Seat_Cushion/FurnitureWithQualityBase/FurnitureBase/BuildingBase XML ancestry; runtime default not asserted.
render_reference.footprint: No explicit size in inspected ancestry; runtime default not asserted.
render_reference.mapping: 1.6 and1.7 LoadFolders use root textures plus1.6 definitions. Exact Seat_Cushion texPath matches inspected PNG.
render_reference.role: Actual flat broad soft cushion supplies map-plane camera, outlined stuffed cloth and restrained tuft shading. No donor four-corner tuft layout, comforts, footprint or colors copied.
render_reference.directional_limit: One Graphic_Single, not three actual directional donor textures. Additional Qud facings are authored rotations of one physical top-plane design; not donor-verified native rotations.

camera.dimensions_status: Authored estimates informed by source low pillow and actual broad floor-cushion reference; not recovered native dimensions.
camera.projection: u=8+rotated_x; v=11.2+0.8*rotated_y-0.65*z. Same fixed elevation for every view. Parallel footprint axes; no diamond yaw.
camera.pattern_rotation: S0,E90,N180,W270 degrees around one center. Pattern3 edge folds rotate with physical pad. Pattern4 diagonal is intrinsic tuft placement, not camera yaw.
camera.volume: Soft crown above continuous low perimeter binding; full broad top visible in each facing. Side not a thin engineering edge.

frame.method: One full-cell mapping for every view, pattern and role. No alpha-bounds fit; shape center remains8,11.2. Ground/front anchor8,16 remains the native-cell proposal.

native_state: RandomTile chooses sw_cushion1..4.bmp, not four facings. Default thumbnail is visibly equivalent to variant1 under actual shader coverage. Native Chair Level-1,2-weight BaseChair-derived furniture, inherited takeability/cover and rare Animated state stay native. Do not infer portability merely from low weight.
native_behavior: Preserve native RandomTile four cosmetic patterns, default visibly equivalent to variant1, Chair Level-1, inherited non-takeability/cover/non-occlusion and rare Animated fallback. Extra directions unbound; no new occupied/folded state.
native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation gate; native RandomTile/default selection, seating/cover/non-takeability and rare Animated fallback plus extra-view placement remain unfinished.
